questions.prompt: How many times does a human heart beat in a day?
reasoning: About 70 beats a minute, times 60 minutes, times 24 hours: 70 × 60 × 24 ≈ 100,800.
Your heart beats around a hundred thousand times before each sunrise.

questions.prompt: How long is the Great Wall of China, in kilometres?
reasoning: All branches and trenches measured together stretch halfway around the Earth.
Walking it end to end would take well over a year.

questions.prompt: How many countries are there in Africa?
reasoning: Africa has 54 fully recognised states — more than any other continent.
The world total is 195, so Africa holds over a quarter of them.
